Politics · India

New Union Education Minister Takes Charge

Union Minister for Education Pralhad Joshi officially took charge of the Ministry of Education on July 26, 2026. He conducted review meetings at Kartavya Bhavan. The Congress party criticized his appointment, saying it was aimed at achieving political hegemony. Joshi accepted the challenge with humility in his first reaction to taking over the education ministry.
